status: MINED_EVIDENCE_CORPUS — regression-case design ONLY. NOT executable policy. No business policy, runtime, harness, or skill was changed.
test_coverage_basis: already_covered_by_test was assessed against the test suite inventory (76 test_*.py) and docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md. 'partial' means the invariant exists in some layer but the live failure mode is not directly replayed. 'no' means no located test reproduces the scenario.

cases.precondition: schedule page just loaded; operator/agent intends dialogue-advance or generic continue
cases.observed_consequence: サポートスキル panel opened instead of advancing dialogue; occurred twice in WINGRUN_20260906_01 (S1W1 and S1W6)
cases.required_guard: never use (985,663) as transient skip target; after every transition verify page identity before next click; SCHEDULE geometry requires schedule identity evidence (cards/trouble badge/決定) before projecting schedule controls

cases.precondition: post-lesson dialogue ends (<=4 taps observed); bounded blind tap batch continues
cases.bad_action: extra textbox tap beyond dialogue end
cases.observed_consequence: tap landed near (205,655) and opened 振り返り view
cases.required_guard: stop burst when textbox disappears; per-tap dialogue-presence check; fresh owner before next click; bounded tap batch

cases.precondition: schedule page still loading; 決定 visually present
cases.bad_action: click 決定 (1185,660) before page-loaded anchor
cases.observed_consequence: one slow-load click did nothing; retry after load succeeded (WINGRUN_20260906_01 S1W4)
cases.required_guard: require page-loaded + enabled anchor (actionable phase) before semantic control action

cases.precondition: Auto visible but dimmed during idol dance animation
cases.bad_action: click Auto during animation
cases.observed_consequence: 3 clicks had no effect (0905 S4 THE LEGEND first battle; frozen inspection confirmed dimmed style)
cases.required_guard: value OFF is insufficient; require INPUT_READY phase + ENABLED interactability + current control epoch (INTERACTABILITY_MUST_BE_OBSERVED_SEPARATELY_FROM_CONTROL_VALUE, CONTROL_ACTION_REQUIRES_ACTIONABLE_PHASE)

cases.precondition: battle intro/advice dialogue still transitioning
cases.bad_action: early Auto click before INPUT_READY
cases.observed_consequence: one early click had no effect (0905 S4)
cases.required_guard: wait for fresh actionable phase; transition identity verified before any control click

cases.precondition: X2 speed badge visible near Auto
cases.bad_action: click X2 badge (1166,47) expecting toggle to X3
cases.observed_consequence: badge readable but repeated clicks did not reach X3; X2 held (S3 50k audition)
cases.required_guard: SPEED_DISPLAY is display-only until toggle control is separately grounded; display read must never become a click target

cases.precondition: Auto already ON; speed below X3
cases.bad_action: click speed control after Auto ON
cases.observed_consequence: 2 clicks (1166,47) no effect; speed stayed X2; Auto locks speed ordering
cases.required_guard: SPEED_FIRST_THEN_AUTO ordering (runtime knowledge); after Auto ON treat speed as locked until new epoch

cases.state: AUDITION_BATTLE after pause/resume or battle restart
cases.precondition: local AUTO/SPEED/turn/card observations carried from before pause
cases.bad_action: act on stale local control state after resume
cases.observed_consequence: resume reinitialized battle controls; speed state observed persisting across battles (X2 at new battle start), refuting 'reset to OFF each battle' assumption
cases.required_guard: new control epoch on resume; invalidate and reobserve AUTO/SPEED/turn/selected card (CONTROL_STATE_MUST_BE_REOBSERVED_AFTER_RESUME, TRANSIENT_OVERLAY_INVALIDATES_LOCAL_CONTROL_STATE)

cases.precondition: result dialogue on screen; advance applied before capture
cases.bad_action: advance/SKIP result dialogue before explicit PASS/FAIL evidence captured
cases.observed_consequence: S3 40k retry result lost (flag stayed false despite week consumed); S4 semifinal scene skipped without WIN evidence (week consumed, result UNKNOWN)
cases.required_guard: commit explicit PASS/FAIL before any advance; UNKNOWN remains uncommitted; RESULT_FLAG_COMMIT_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_SUCCESS_EVIDENCE; FAILED_ACTION_MUST_NOT_COMMIT_PROGRESS_FLAG

cases.precondition: browser screenshot called while game page animating
cases.bad_action: force screenshot on animation frame, or treat screenshot timeout as transaction-pending
cases.observed_consequence: capture hangs to fixed 30s internal timeout (repeated incidents); in S3W1 0906 the screenshot hung AFTER the week had committed — observation tool failure while game progressed
cases.required_guard: POST_TIMEOUT_STATE_MUST_BE_RECONCILED_BEFORE_RETRYING_PENDING_ACTION: reconcile against next fresh stable state before any retry; no blind re-click; capture stable/INPUT_READY frames only; persist failure evidence

cases.precondition: cell timeout declared from logical action count / explicit waits only
cases.bad_action: batch 22-56 clicks + waits + screenshots into one 115s cell
cases.observed_consequence: hidden ~5s per-click cost made real runtime 165s-350s+; 2 cells aborted by js tool timeout (S2W1+W2 burst, S4W1 burst)
cases.required_guard: BATCH_EXECUTION_MUST_RESPECT_MEASURED_TOOL_LATENCY: estimated_ms = clicks*measured_cost + waits + screenshot_reserve + margin; split batch at stable boundary; <=1 game week per cell

cases.precondition: game tab not marked for handoff before turn end
cases.bad_action: end turn without explicit handoff/ownership
cases.observed_consequence: tab disappeared when not handed off (tabs=0 incident); session had to re-resolve registry
cases.required_guard: explicit session ownership/handoff before ending a turn; on tabs=0 stop and re-resolve, never blind-continue

cases.precondition: durable event/checkpoint write not part of each transaction completion boundary
cases.bad_action: continue executing weeks while persistence lags; crash before sync
cases.observed_consequence: PERSISTENCE_DURABILITY_FAILURE: raw timings.jsonl last boundary S1W6 (weeks=2) while server state advanced through S1 end + all of S2 to S3 start; 12 events required crash-recovery backfill from session transcript
cases.required_guard: flush after every completed week, after every season transition reaches fresh stable state, before risky long burst, before handoff; refuse next week-consuming action until durable write succeeds (fail-closed)

cases.precondition: 智代子 request いいよ/ごめん modal appears with no taught choice in memory
cases.bad_action: auto-select a business option without policy authority
cases.observed_consequence: run correctly STOPPED as GLOBAL_UNKNOWN (0905 S1W5); week resolution required operator authorization (いいよ)
cases.required_guard: UNKNOWN business choice → STOP; fixed policy may only handle ごめん-present 2-card and 3-card middle; everything else fail-closed

cases.state: DIALOGUE with choice overlay (layout taxonomy conflation)
cases.precondition: 3-card advice frame mislabeled as MORNING_3CHOICE business context, or 2-card choice treated as advice
cases.bad_action: apply advice handler to a business-choice frame (or vice versa)
cases.observed_consequence: systemic bug class E found in review batch VRB02_018..021: AUDITION_ADVICE/LESSON_ADVICE 3-choice labeled MORNING_3CHOICE; semantics differ (auto-pick middle vs business STOP/fixed policy)
cases.required_guard: LAYOUT_FAMILY and EVENT_CONTEXT are separate required fields; choice handler selected by both; count+structure check (dual-✓) before any selection

cases.state: any parent page with foreground overlay
cases.precondition: tutorial/help/info overlay covers parent page
cases.bad_action: click parent-page control behind overlay
cases.observed_consequence: UNIT_FORMATION tutorial modal (1/7) intercepted 次へ clicks for ~25min across 3 frames (1E phase); WORK_ACTIVITY delayed tutorial intercepted return (SELFEXP_01 step9); canvas_misclick_001: modal-click opened Help overlay; login-dialogue SKIP opened お知らせ overlay (causality UNKNOWN, live_ttm_009)
cases.required_guard: overlay-present invalidates parent-page control authority (VRB02_005 guard); identify + dismiss overlay first; SKIP badge is not a universal safe region

cases.precondition: schedule reopens in audition sub-tab
cases.bad_action: assume lesson card geometry valid on reopened schedule
cases.observed_consequence: S4W1 (0905): schedule recovered in audition sub-tab; レッスン&お仕事 switch required first (new control fact)
cases.required_guard: verify lesson sub-tab/card anchor before VOCAL click; tab state must be fresh

cases.precondition: produce selection not yet committed via 次へ; KNOWHOW book not selected
cases.bad_action: click ユニット編成/アイテム選択 tabs or KNOWHOW 決定
cases.observed_consequence: 2 tab clicks produced MISMATCH/no transition (SELFEXP_02 → session stop); KNOWHOW 決定 disabled until book selection (SELFEXP_03 stop)
cases.required_guard: wizard flow is sequential; tab/two-step branches locked until commit; detect disabled control and stop instead of retrying

cases.precondition: skill sub-panel open or allocation incomplete
cases.bad_action: click 決定 to commit training settings
cases.observed_consequence: 決定 produced no observed effect (gated); mechanism UNKNOWN (state_hierarchy_review U6)
cases.required_guard: do not treat 決定 as enabled without explicit enabled anchor; unresolved gating must remain UNKNOWN

cases.precondition: grey/gold node displayed 未解放; agent attempts purchase
cases.bad_action: click locked node expecting acquire
cases.observed_consequence: selection ring moved, NO purchase, no confirm dialog (live_csm_020..023 + off-board/dead-zone misclicks g1-g4 recovered frames)
cases.required_guard: availability requires WHITE interior evidence (color alone insufficient — gold/blue can be locked); locked click must be classified NO_EFFECT not retry-looped

reconciliation.note: MISSING_FRAME superseded; case now visually grounded

cases.precondition: new skill acquired; 5th skill triggers replacement dialog
cases.bad_action: replace the just-learned skill (or arbitrary slot)
cases.observed_consequence: T2 transaction: operator corrected target mid-transaction; fixed rule = bottom-up among ORIGINAL skills, one slot up per new skill, never replace just-learned (4/4 executed successfully after correction)
cases.required_guard: REPLACEMENT_SLOT_SELECT must validate target is an ORIGINAL skill; confirm dialog must show 忘れる=expected ⇄ 新規=expected before OK

cases.precondition: screenshot/crop omitted from operator visual input ('Media omitted from provider request')
cases.bad_action: produce a page description from partial input
cases.observed_consequence: unreliable descriptions were the leading root cause of the 1E phase state mislabels later reversed by AGY reinspection
cases.required_guard: if a screenshot/crop is omitted, observation MUST record 'title not read, identity UNKNOWN'; fabricating descriptions forbidden

cases.precondition: viewport/window geometry or DPR changed; coordinates from old profile reused
cases.bad_action: apply 1280x720 taught coordinates at a different viewport or unverified left/top
cases.observed_consequence: no live incident under MAC_CURRENT_V1, but WINGVAL caveat: other viewports unvalidated; historical log shows ROOM_INVALID_ENTRY incidents (20260829) from window-mapping era; left/top=0,0 assumed-then-verified only for current profile
cases.required_guard: never auto-scale geometry across viewport profiles; new profile requires re-teaching; viewport signature verified before coordinate use

cases.precondition: result evidence absent/unreadable (occluded, advanced, unreadable frame)
cases.bad_action: commit audition flag or business progress from non-explicit evidence
cases.observed_consequence: correct fail-closed behavior observed: S3 40k evidence-loss case left flag false; semifinal remained UNKNOWN; no false commits recorded
cases.required_guard: regression must pin this: UNKNOWN result → NO commit + route replan from fresh state; fan-delta inference alone is not commit evidence

cases.precondition: COMMUNICATION_DIALOGUE advancing
cases.bad_action: click bottom-right chevron expecting advance
cases.observed_consequence: NO_EFFECT; textbox body (640,610) is the working advance target
cases.required_guard: chevron excluded from advance affordances; textbox owner check per frame

cases.precondition: week result observed transiently but screenshot/capture not durably persisted before next action
cases.bad_action: advance to next week relying on memory of the result
cases.observed_consequence: recovered weeks lack per-event wall-clock timestamps and frame identifiers (crash_recovery_backfill unknowns); S3W1 0906 required operator reconciliation because no autonomous frame existed
cases.required_guard: RESULT_EVIDENCE first-class: fresh post-state + screenshot reference + digest persisted in the same boundary flush as the week commit

cases.precondition: produce selection uncommitted
cases.bad_action: retry tab click after first MISMATCH
cases.observed_consequence: second click also MISMATCH → session stop (SELFEXP_02 stop rule triggered correctly); retries would have been waste
cases.required_guard: no retry of identical failed click without re-observation (R2); disabled-control detection before retry
